tagline: Be Afraid. Be Kind of Afraid.

Cheddar and oat biscuits, cut like bones.How to make it150g plain flour50g rolled oats100g cold butter, cubed120g vintage cheddar, grated1 egg yolk2 tbsp cold water1 tsp sweet paprikaPulse the flour, oats, butter, cheese and paprika in a food processor until it looks like breadcrumbs.Add the yolk and water and pulse until it comes together, then wrap and chill for 10 minutes.Roll out 5mm thick and cut into bone shapes.Bake on a lined tray at 180°C until golden, then cool on the tray.Hot pepper challenge pizza bitesScooby eats the whole jar of peppers. Mini cheese and tomato pizzas, mild peppers on the side.How to make it4 small pita breads or pizza bases125ml passata1 tsp dried oregano200g mozzarella, grated12 cherry tomatoes, halved100g mild pickled banana peppers2 tbsp basil leavesStir the passata with the oregano and a pinch of salt.Spread over the bases and top with mozzarella and tomatoes.Bake at 220°C until bubbling and crisp, then cut into wedges.Scatter with basil and serve the peppers in a jar on the side for the brave.A jar of hot peppers, for the braveKetchup on standby.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.From the Fire PitAll-you-can-eat huli huli chicken with pineapple riceSpooky Island's all-you-can-eat deal. Sticky pineapple and soy chicken, coconut rice.How to make it1kg chicken thigh fillets125ml pineapple juice80ml soy sauce80ml tomato sauce60g brown sugar2 tsp grated ginger2 garlic cloves, crushed300g jasmine rice270ml tin coconut milk225g tin pineapple pieces, drained2 spring onions, slicedWhisk the pineapple juice, soy, tomato sauce, sugar, ginger and garlic, keep a third aside and marinate the chicken in the rest for 15 minutes.Cook the rice in the coconut milk topped up with water until fluffy, then fold through the pineapple.Grill the chicken over medium heat, turning and basting with the kept sauce, until sticky and cooked through.Slice and serve over the rice with spring onions.Unmasked Scrappy-Doo meatball subsMondavarious is really Scrappy-Doo. Beef meatballs, tomato sauce, melted mozzarella.How to make it500g beef mince40g fresh breadcrumbs1 egg30g parmesan, grated1 tsp dried oregano2 tbsp olive oil700g jar tomato pasta sauce4 long soft rolls150g mozzarella, slicedMix the mince, crumbs, egg, parmesan, oregano and salt and roll into 16 balls.Brown the meatballs in the oil, then pour in the sauce and simmer until cooked through.Split the rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce and lay the mozzarella on top.Grill until the cheese melts and serve hot.Something SweetDisco ball coconut snowballsDaphne bounces the sun off a disco ball. Vanilla ice cream rolled in toasted coconut, mango sauce.How to make it1 L vanilla ice cream150g shredded coconut1 ripe mango, chopped1 tbsp honey1 limeToast the coconut in a dry pan until golden, then cool.Scoop 8 big balls of ice cream, roll in the coconut and freeze on a lined tray.Blend the mango with the honey and a squeeze of lime.Serve two snowballs each in a puddle of mango sauce.Lagoon CoolersJinkies Mystery Machine punchScrappy gets kicked out of the van.
